about: A batch for the Model Forge: every entry becomes Web/props/<id>.glb. Run: gh workflow run forge.yml -f action=batch -f spec=Tools/forge/requests/example.json. Fields: id, prompt and/or images (https URLs or paths relative to this file, front/left/back/right), height|width|length in metres, yaw (degrees to turn its front to +Z), pipeline, faces, seed.

models.prompt: a white Japanese outdoor drink vending machine, rows of illuminated plastic bottle dummies, coin slot, slightly weathered, rain streaks
a grey plastic Japanese street rubbish bin with a burnable-waste sticker, scuffed
a silver Japanese mamachari city bicycle with a front wire basket and kickstand, used
